latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Architecture Quantum Analyzer skill.

- Analyzes system architecture quanta to guide decisions between monolith and distributed designs.
- Helps identify independent deployment boundaries based on component coupling, deployment, and quality attribute needs.
- Supports both codebase-driven and greenfield/system description analyses.
- Guides users through component identification, communication mapping, and grouping into quanta.
- Designed as a prerequisite for architectural style selection and monolith decomposition.
- Requires prior identification of system architecture characteristics.
